title: Founder Runtime Approval Decision Application Authority Handoff
objective: Render governed local authority handoff safe dry-run UX on scoped Command Center founder work pages without enabling live application, DB/runtime writes, execution, dispatch, project mutation, provider calls, deploy, release, export, package, network, or spend authority in P122.5.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval decision application in P122.5.
Do not enable approval capture, approval persistence, or approve/reject decision recording in P122.5.
Do not enable DB writes, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, runtime writes, runtime execution, or execution unlock in P122.5.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P122.5.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/log/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw DB names, raw report paths in primary UX, fake runnable actions, or mutation controls.
Future P122 subphases must define narrow authority, validation, UX, and rollback before any later phase can consider live behavior.
reuseRequirements: P121 approval decision application boundary evidence
knownLimitations: P122.5 is scoped Command Center UX only and does not enable live authority.

Approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.
